name: CANON_V1-Surveys T1
text_html:
CANON V1-Surveys (REDCap event visit_1_arm_1), in this order:

  1. Satisfaction With Life Scale (SWLS)
  2. Dispositional Positive Emotion Scales (DPES)
  3. Scale Of Positive And Negative Experience (SPANE)
  4. Well-Being Assessment (WBA)
  5. Race/Ethnicity/Religion
  6. Socio Economic Status (SES)
  7. Cultural Orientation Scale (COS)
  8. Connor-Davidson Resilience Scale (CD-RISC-10)
  9. Career Satisfaction Scale (CSS)
  10. Life Orientation Test Revised (LOT-R)
  11. Overall Anxiety Severity And Impairment Scale (OASIS)
  12. Perceived Resource Availability (PRA)
  13. Internal, Personal, and Situational Attributions Questionnaire (IPSAQ)
  14. Anxiety Sensitivity Index (ASI-3)
  15. Retrospective Family Unpredictability Scale (Retro-FUS)
  16. Beck Depression Inventory II (BDI-II)
  17. Difficulties In Emotion Regulation Scale (DERS)
  18. Psychiatric Diagnostic Screening Questionnaire (PDSQ)
  19. Adverse Childhood Experiences Questionnaire (ACES)
  20. Stanford Sleepiness Scale – Modified (SSS)
